stories.title: Russian state-sponsored cyber gang targets Flintshire County Council systems
stories.summary: A Russian state-sponsored cyber gang attempted to access Flintshire County Council’s computer systems within the past month, the council’s most senior governance officer has told a committee meeting. stories.title: By-elections called in two Flintshire wards with votes set for 9 July
stories.summary: Voters in two Flintshire wards will go to the polls on 9 July after by-elections were called in Argoed and New Brighton and Connah’s Quay Central. stories.title: Welsh Water handed £44.7m ‘enforcement package’ over sewage failures
stories.summary: Welsh Water will pay out £44.7 million after failures in its sewage network and oversight led to a series of spills and must now focus on “putting things right”, regulator Ofwat has announced. stories.title: Appeal to find missing 15-year-old Rhys from Connah’s Quay
stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for information to help find a 15-year-old boy missing from Connah’s Quay. Rhys was last seen at 1.30pm on Thursday 4 June. stories.title: Hawarden teenager targets quadcross world championship after sponsorship from Deeside homebuilder
stories.summary: A 17-year-old quadcross rider from Hawarden is preparing to compete in the FIM Quad Cross World Championship after receiving sponsorship from Ewloe-based Anwyl Homes.
